title: The 1 AI skill that will make you irreplaceable

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What one AI skill will make humans irreplaceable in a world where machines can do almost anything?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Mastery of interpretative reasoning — AI can now code, but understanding human intent in ambiguous contexts remains elusive.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If AI lacks empathy and ethical judgment, it may make decisions that are technically sound but morally harmful.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating explainable AI and value alignment frameworks to ensure systems reflect human values.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine AI that not only solves problems but does so with fairness, compassion, and cultural awareness.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future belongs to those who can guide AI with wisdom, not just power.

video_cue: A human and AI collaborator working side by side in a futuristic lab, solving a complex ethical dilemma.
